title: How Long Can Dark Spots Take to Fade? Realistic Timelines by Type of Mark
ex: Tanning, acne marks, sun spots and melasma all behave differently. Here are honest, typical timelines and how to help dark spots look less noticeable.
rt: How Long Can Dark Spots Take to Fade? | Mirc Glow
rd: How long can dark spots take to fade? Typical timelines for tanning, acne marks, sun spots and melasma, what slows them down, and when to see a doctor.
keyword: how long can dark spots take to fade
quick: It depends on the mark. Light tanning may look less noticeable in a few weeks, brown acne marks often take 3 to 6 months, and sun spots or melasma can last much longer. With a gentle routine and daily sunscreen, judge your progress after 8 to 12 weeks.
facts: Skin renews roughly every 4 to 6 weeks, more slowly with age.
Brown post-acne marks often take 3 to 6 months, sometimes longer.
Daily sun exposure is the main reason marks seem stuck.
Melasma tends to come back and needs a dermatologist's plan.
